description: This PHP source file defines the MenuItemAPI class in the OrangeHRM mobile plugin API. The class provides an endpoint to list mobile menu items based on user role and enabled modules, incorporating traits for authentication, configuration, and services. It dynamically constructs menu structures for different user types (e.g., ESS) and modules (leave, time).

classes.name: MenuItemAPI
classes.description: The MenuItemAPI class handles the retrieval of available mobile menu items based on user roles and enabled modules. It constructs different menu structures for supervisors and ESS users, returning data with associated metadata.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Returns a list of menu items available for the authenticated user, considering their role and active modules. It also includes metadata about leave and timesheet periods.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, specifically excluding the ID parameter.
